name: Plutocracy intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

pl2.say: The Gyre builds it, yes — but it will orbit US. A sun of Pluto's own. And when it lights, no astronomer alive will dare write 'dwarf' next to our name again.

ple2.say: Then run fast, little herald. Light takes five hours to reach Earth from here — your warning will be racing it the whole way.

pl1.say: Ah. The famous investigator, here at the edge of everything. Do you know what they took from us, before you were even born? A WORD. 'Planet.' One word, and the whole system stopped writing.

options.label: Cut
options.text: The Second Sun. It's yours, isn't it?

pe2.say: Behind you, the Plutocracy begins erasing its ledgers. The race to sunrise has started.

pe1.say: The sun sets on Earth. Somewhere past Neptune, a second dawn is loading.

pl3.say: So. The ledgers are open, the manifest is in your coat, and the question, investigator, is what you do with your evening.

options.label: Side
options.text: A sun for Pluto. Honestly? Earned.

options.label: Expose
options.text: The whole system will know by morning. All of it.

options.label: Broker
options.text: There's a third way: share the Second Sun. Every outpost, one sky.

ple3.say: ...A shared dawn. The Mercurials prophesied a Red Nova; perhaps prophecy is only a plan that no one has priced yet. Bring us the system's signatures, investigator. Pluto will sign last — but Pluto will sign.

ple1.say: We knew you were reasonable. Wear this signet — when the new dawn comes, it will mark you a Friend of Pluto.

pe3.say: One sky. Thirteen outposts. A sun that belongs to everyone. The Accord begins with you.
